item.title: Greece launches an animal airlift to evacuate pets and their owners from the Mideast
item.summary: Dozens of dogs and cats have arrived in Athens with their owners aboard a special evacuation flight for Greeks with pets who were trapped by the current war in the Middle East

item.title: Gunmen kill at least 15 in attacks on 2 villages in northwestern Nigeria, authorities say
item.summary: Gunmen killed at least 15 people in attacks on two villages in northwestern Nigeria, officials and residents say

item.title: Five EU leaders seek urgent solution for drifting Russian tanker to avoid environmental catastrophe
item.summary: Five European nations have banded together on Wednesday, seeking an urgent solution for an unmanned Russian tanker currently drifting in the Mediterranean they say poses risk of an environmental catastrophe, the office of Spanish Prime Minister Pedro S...

item.title: 2 found with hundreds of ants are charged with illegally dealing in wildlife in Kenya
item.summary: A Chinese national and a local man were criminally charged over possession of live ants in the case that could further shine a spotlight on the trade in rare wildlife

item.title: Pakistan announces 'temporary pause' in strikes against Afghanistan at request of several countries
item.summary: Pakistan has announced a pause in strikes against Afghanistan, saying the decision was made ahead of the Muslim holiday of Eid al-Fitr at the request of Saudi Arabia, Qatar and Turkey

item.title: At least 17 dead in fighting on Sudan's border with Chad, aid group says
item.summary: Attacks on a town along Sudan’s border with Chad have killed at least 17 people and injured 123, Doctors Without Borders, or MSF, said

item.title: Emergency room for injured wild birds opens at Warsaw Zoo in Poland
item.summary: Warsaw Zoo has created a new emergency drop-off system that gets injured birds treated fast

item.title: El Salvador's Bukele pushes through life sentences in nation that has imprisoned 1% of population
item.summary: El Salvador's President Nayib Bukele and his party pushed through a constitutional reform that will permit life sentences in a country that has imprisoned more than 1% of its population in its war on gangs

item.title: Hungary and Slovakia strike a new fuel pipeline deal to steady regional supplies
item.summary: Hungary and Slovakia are agreeing to build a new pipeline that links their refineries in what they say will boost regional fuel security

item.title: Macron names next nuclear-powered aircraft carrier 'France Libre' as a symbol of independence
item.summary: President Emmanuel Macron has named France’s next nuclear-powered aircraft carrier France Libre, or Free France, framing it as a symbol of independence and military power
